instruction: Push the T-shaped block to align it precisely with the gray T-shaped pad.

frames.label: turn 1: Close the gripper into a pusher. Rules that hold all the way through: the T is SHOVED, never picked up - one frame with it even a finger's width off the table fails the whole episode - so the gripper stays closed, stays down beside the block and never reaches over it; and it only counts once both arms are back at their rest pose. Right now the grey pad lies nearer the robot and to the left of the red T; the T is turned anticlockwise of the pad, so the two stems do not point the same way.
